Job Description
 Why This Role Matters
 Publicis Sapient is looking for an experienced Murex CTRM Test Lead to lead end-to-end test management for a complex SaaS transformation covering both physical and financial trading across precious metals, base metals, energy, FX, interest rates, and cash.
In this hands-on leadership role, you ll take ownership of the overall testing strategy and quality assurance approach across the Murex CTRM platform, connected applications, interfaces, data migration, and critical front-to-back business processes.
You ll work closely with business users, QA teams, technology teams, and Murex stakeholders to ensure comprehensive test coverage across the full trade lifecycle, from pricing and trade capture through risk, operations, treasury, accounting, and reporting. You ll also play a key role in defect management, quality-risk assessment, and go-live readiness.
You ll thrive in this role if you combine strong knowledge of physical and financial trading with hands-on experience leading testing across large-scale Murex or similarly complex trading transformation programmes.
This role is an excellent opportunity for someone who would like to join an international global organization with a start-up mentality. We highly value Openness, Collaboration, Learning Mindset and partner with our clients to drive positive outcomes.
 Where You ll Make an Impact
Define, own, and drive the integrated test strategy, test plans, governance, entry and exit criteria, traceability, and quality reporting.
Lead functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and business acceptance testing.
Ensure comprehensive test coverage across the full trade lifecycle, including:
Pricing and trade capture
Real-time position management and P&L
Trade events and lifecycle processing
Market and credit risk
Back-office and operational processes
Treasury, accounting, and reporting
Coordinate testing across Murex and associated inbound and outbound interfaces.
Manage test environments, test data, system dependencies, resources, and release-aligned execution cycles.
Lead defect triage, prioritisation, resolution tracking, and quality-risk assessment.
Coordinate testing activities across business users, QA teams, technology teams, and Murex stakeholders.
Establish an effective testing approach across integrated systems and business processes.
Provide clear visibility into testing progress, quality risks, defects, and readiness to senior stakeholders.
Support go-live readiness assessments and quality-based release decisions.
 What You Ll Bring To The Team
Proven experience as a Test Lead or Test Manager within Murex, CTRM, trading platforms, or similarly complex transformation programmes.
Strong functional understanding of physical and financial trading.
Solid knowledge of front-to-back trading processes across Front Office, risk, operations, treasury, accounting, and reporting.
Strong understanding of the complete trade lifecycle, including pricing, trade capture, position management, P&L, trade events, risk, settlement, and reporting.
Demonstrated experience defining and implementing end-to-end test strategies for complex, business-critical platforms.
Strong experience across functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and business acceptance testing.
Proven ability to lead test governance, defect management, quality reporting, and risk assessment.
Excellent stakeholder management and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technology teams.
Strong communication skills, including experience providing clear quality and readiness reporting to senior and executive stakeholders.
Ability to operate effectively in complex transformation environments involving multiple systems, teams, dependencies, and releases.
 Additional Experience We Value
Experience with Murex implementations, upgrades, migrations, or SaaS transformation programmes.
Experience testing complex integrated landscapes involving SaaS platforms, legacy applications, APIs and interfaces, market venues, and reporting solutions.
Experience validating complex data migration and reconciliation activities.
Exposure to Commodities Trading and Risk Management (CTRM) environments across precious metals, base metals, and energy.
Experience working with FX, interest rates, cash products, and other financial instruments.
Knowledge of testing approaches for real-time positions, P&L, market risk, and credit risk.
Experience coordinating business acceptance testing across multiple business functions and geographies.
Experience managing testing dependencies across third-party platforms and inbound/outbound interfaces.
Strong understanding of release management and go-live readiness within large-scale trading or financial services transformation programmes
 Additional Information
 What You’ll Get in Return
A fast-paced tech environment
Continuous growth & learning
Open feedback culture
Room for own initiative & ideas
Transparency about results & strategy
Recognition & reward for hard work
Working with a flexible schedule 
Medical subscription
Meal tickets
Extra vacation days - starting with 25 vacation days
Many others perks 
 Company Description
 About Publicis Sapient
 Most companies in the AI era do one of two things: they advise, or they sell you a tool. We do both. Publicis Sapient is a technology company that provides enterprise AI platforms and services, which means we build our own AI platforms and bring the strategists, product thinkers, designers and engineers who make them work inside the world s most complex businesses. It is where people and products shape the future of enterprise, and where your ideas actually reach the organizations that run the world. If you want to question how things are done, learn continuously and do the best work of your career alongside 20,000 people across 28 countries, you re in the right place. Come build with us.
 Our Commitment to Inclusive Hiring 
 We are committed to fostering and encouraging an inclusive and welcoming environment for everyone and we believe great talent comes from many different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. That is why we are committed to creating a hiring process where everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed and feel safe. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and identities including: race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion and value the diverse experiences, perspectives, and strengths they bring to our teams.
If there is anything we can do to make our recruitment process more accessible or comfortable for you, please let us know. We are happy to provide reasonable adjustments throughout the application and interview process. You can contact us anytime at emeahiringteam@publicissapient.com
 Your Safety Matters To Us
 At Publicis Sapient, we are committed to protecting candidates throughout every step of their journey with us. To help you stay safe from recruitment scams, please remember that our recruiters will only ever contact you from a Publicis Sapient email address. In some cases, we may partner with trusted, vetted recruitment agencies who will clearly identify themselves as working on behalf of Publicis Sapient. If you receive communication from any other domain claiming to represent us, please treat it with caution and contact us at emeahiringteam@publicissapient.com
